resources.string: Detects and immediately blocks YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels screens. Screen content is evaluated on-device only and never transmitted or stored anywhere.
Protection is OFF — accessibility service disabled
Blocks YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.\nYouTube long-form videos and Instagram DMs/feed still work normally.
Optional: If denied, LockedIn still guards and blocks normally, but the status notification stays completely silent and hidden.
On Xiaomi/Huawei/Samsung/Oppo/OnePlus also enable \"Autostart\" and exclude LockedIn from battery cleaning under the phone\'s Settings → Apps, or the system may kill the watchdog.
Set up PIN and get started
If installed outside the Play Store, enabling this app under Settings > Accessibility\nmay require an extra confirmation step.

How the hard lock works: turning blocking off inside the app requires the PIN. If the accessibility service is switched off in system Settings anyway, the watchdog notices within seconds and covers the screen with a lock wall until the service is re-enabled.
Turning off blocking will make short-form content visible again. PIN entry is required to continue.
Enter a PIN of 4+ digits to protect the Settings screen
Recovery question (used if you forget your PIN)
PIN must be at least 4 digits
Enter a recovery question and answer
Confirm and set a new PIN

LockedIn\'s accessibility service was disabled in system Settings.\n\nShort-form content is unblocked until it is restored. Re-enable \"LockedIn detection service\" under Settings → Accessibility to dismiss this screen.
